_readme: Single timing source for the promo. All times in 'cues' and 'scenes' are VIDEO seconds (video t = camera t - source.voiceIn). Edit, then run: node retime.mjs. If you change 'source', rebuild the media first: sh prep.sh

source._screenLead: screen-recording t = camera t + screenLead (checked on the REC timer ticks at 0:10, 0:29 and 0:30)

cues._note: speech cues are measured on audio/voiceover.wav (video seconds); skippedLine and jump are read from the screen footage
